question: In a certain code language, 'NATURE' is written as 'MASUQE'. How will 'POTATO' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/147f4e31f8cfc14c8117bccc3833f239daf8740b27e5678418d3f215419352f9.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

Consonants alphabet positional value are subtracted by -1.

Vowels are coded as it is.

'NATURE' is written as 'MASUQE'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec73266d94a7105bc08925dd15e588ba4e61d94b842a8b21a78408e9a97bc352.png] 

Similarly,

'POTATO' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fea6004e96b06b85925fa031d3a9026dac833e3eecad9f122072e9bd4ba1fa41.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OOSASO".**
